lessons.title: HTML Kya Hai?
lessons.concept: Socho tum ek ghar bana rahe ho. Furniture aur paint baad me aayega, lekin pehle deeware aur rooms banana padta hai. HTML bhi website ka structure banata hai. Ye browser ko batata hai ki page par kya-kya hona chahiye.

code_breakdown.explain: Ye opening heading tag hai. Iske baad jo text likhte ho wo sabse badi heading banta hai. HTML me h1 se h6 tak headings hoti hain. h1 sabse badi aur h6 sabse chhoti hoti hai. Aksar ek page me sirf ek h1 rakhna best practice mana jata hai.
Ye heading ka actual text hai. Iski jagah tum apna naam, website title ya koi bhi heading likh sakte ho.
Ye closing tag hai. Browser ko batata hai ki heading yahin khatam ho gayi.
Ye paragraph ka opening tag hai. Normal text likhne ke liye use hota hai. Agar lambi information likhni ho to paragraph use karte hain.
Ye paragraph ke andar likha hua normal text hai. Iski jagah tum koi bhi sentence likh sakte ho.
Ye paragraph ka closing tag hai. Browser ko batata hai ki paragraph yahan khatam ho gaya.
Ye angle bracket tag ki shuruaat dikhata hai. Lagbhag har HTML tag isi symbol se start hota hai.
Ye angle bracket tag ka end batata hai. Browser iske baad content padhna shuru karta hai.

Closing tag me slash batata hai ki ye tag band ho raha hai. Jaise aur

.

practice_reps.instruction: Heading ko apne naam se replace karo aur niche ek paragraph me apne baare me ek line likho.

lessons.mini_task: Ek page banao jisme ek h1 heading aur uske niche do alag paragraphs likho. Heading me apna naam aur paragraphs me apne hobbies aur favourite game likho.
lessons.why_it_matters: Har website HTML se hi shuru hoti hai. Agar HTML samajh aa gaya to CSS aur JavaScript seekhna bahut aasaan ho jata hai.
lessons.common_mistake:
Bahut beginners closing tag bhool jate hain, jaise ya

. Hamesha check karo ki opening aur closing dono tags maujood hon.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: h1 se h6 mein sabse badi heading kaunsi hoti hai?
Paragraph likhne ke liye kaunsa tag use hota hai? (bina brackets ke likho, jaise: p)

quiz_after_practice.question: Closing tag mein sabse pehle kaunsa symbol aata hai?

lessons.title: Headings Aur Paragraph
lessons.concept: Socho tum ek kitab padh rahe ho. Har chapter ka ek bada title hota hai aur uske niche uski details likhi hoti hain. Website me bhi headings aur paragraphs isi tarah information ko organize karte hain, jisse padhna aasaan ho jata hai.
lessons.example_code:
Mera Portfolio

About Me

Main HTML seekh raha hoon aur mobile se websites banana practice kar raha hoon.

code_breakdown.explain: Sabse badi heading ka opening tag. Page ka main title dikhane ke liye use hota hai. HTML me h1 se h6 tak headings hoti hain. h1 sabse badi aur h6 sabse chhoti hoti hai.
Ye heading ka text hai. Iski jagah tum apna naam, website ka naam ya project ka title likh sakte ho.
Heading ko close karta hai. Har opening h1 tag ka closing hamesha hona chahiye.
Second level heading ka opening tag. Ye main heading ke andar kisi section ka title dikhane ke liye use hota hai. Agar aur chhote sections hon to h3, h4, h5 aur h6 bhi use kar sakte ho.
Ye section ka naam hai. Iski jagah Skills, Projects, Contact ya Education bhi likh sakte ho.
Second level heading ko close karta hai.
Paragraph ka opening tag. Normal information, description ya story likhne ke liye use hota hai.

code_breakdown.part: Main HTML seekh raha hoon aur mobile se websites banana practice kar raha hoon.
code_breakdown.explain: Ye paragraph ka content hai. Isme tum jitna chahe normal text likh sakte ho.
Paragraph ko close karta hai.
Har HTML tag ki shuruaat is symbol se hoti hai.
Tag ka end batata hai.
Closing tag me use hota hai aur batata hai ki tag yahan khatam ho gaya.

practice_reps.instruction: Ek h1 me apna naam likho, ek h2 me 'My Hobbies' likho aur niche ek paragraph me apni favourite hobby likho.

lessons.mini_task: Apna ek mini profile page banao jisme h1 me apna naam, h2 me 'About Me' aur uske niche do paragraphs likho. Pehle paragraph me apne baare me aur dusre me apna favourite game ya movie likho.
lessons.why_it_matters: Blogs, portfolio websites, news sites aur almost har webpage headings aur paragraphs ka use karta hai. Ye content ko clean aur readable banate hain.
lessons.common_mistake: Bahut beginners sirf h1 hi baar-baar use karte hain. Har heading h1 nahi hoti. Main title ke liye h1 aur sections ke liye h2, h3 waqera use karna better practice hai.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Ek page mein kitne h1 rakhna best practice hai?

quiz_after_practice.question: 'About Me' jaisa section title dikhane ke liye h1 ke andar kaunsa heading tag best hai? (jaise: h2)

lessons.title: Links Aur Buttons
lessons.concept: Socho tum ek mall me ho. Ek board tumhe dusri shop tak le jata hai, aur ek lift ka button dabane par action hota hai. Website me bhi Link user ko dusre page par le jata hai, jabki Button kisi action ko start karne ke liye use hota hai.

code_breakdown.explain: Ye Anchor tag ka opening part hai. Anchor tag links banane ke liye use hota hai.
href ka matlab Hypertext Reference hota hai. Isme batate hain ki click karne par user kahan jayega. Ye kisi website, file ya page ke section ka address ho sakta hai.
Ye URL (website address) hai. Iski jagah tum https://youtube.com, https://github.com ya apni website ka link bhi de sakte ho.
Ye opening tag ko khatam karta hai. Iske baad link ka text likha jata hai.
Ye clickable text hai. User isi text par tap ya click karta hai. Iski jagah koi bhi naam likh sakte ho.
Ye Anchor tag ko close karta hai. Har opening ka closing hona chahiye.
Button ka opening tag hai. Button click karne ke liye dikhaya jata hai. Sirf HTML me button dikhega, action baad me JavaScript se add karenge.
Ye button par dikhne wala text hai. Iski jagah Submit, Login, Register, Buy Now ya Contact Me likh sakte ho.
Ye button tag ko close karta hai.
Har HTML tag ki shuruaat is symbol se hoti hai.
Ye batata hai ki tag complete ho gaya.
Closing tag me use hota hai aur batata hai ki element yahan khatam ho gaya.

practice_reps.instruction: Ek link banao jo YouTube khole aur uske niche ek button banao jiska text 'Start Learning' ho.
Ab ek link banao jo GitHub khole, aur do buttons banao: 'Contact Me' aur 'View Projects'.

lessons.mini_task: Ek chhota webpage banao jisme ek h1 heading 'My Favourite Websites' ho. Uske niche Google aur YouTube ke do alag links banao aur sabse niche 'Visit More' naam ka ek button add karo.
lessons.why_it_matters: Har website me navigation links aur buttons hote hain. Login, Signup, Buy Now, Contact Us aur Menu sab isi concept par kaam karte hain.
lessons.common_mistake: Bahut beginners href attribute likhna bhool jate hain ya URL ke around quotes ("") nahi lagate. Agar href nahi hoga to link sahi tarah kaam nahi karega.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: href attribute kis tag ke saath use hota hai?
href ka full form kya hai? (Hint: Hypertext ______)

quiz_after_practice.question: Agar href attribute hi na ho to link ka kya hoga?

lessons.title: Images aur Media add karna
lessons.concept: Socho tum ek khali deewar par photo frame lagaye ho. HTML ka image tag wahi frame hai, jisme tum picture ka address (URL) daal kar use web page par show karte ho. Ye user ko text se zyada visually engage karta hai.

code_breakdown.explain: Ye 'image' tag ka shuruat hai. Yaad rakho, img tag ek 'self-closing' tag hota hai, yani iska alag se </img> tag nahi hota.
Iska full form 'Source' hai. Ye attribute batata hai ki photo file kahan rakhi hai (ya uska internet address kya hai).
Quotes. Kisi bhi file path ya URL ko hamesha double quotes ke andar likhte hain taaki browser use sahi se read kare.
'Alternative text'. Agar kisi wajah se photo load na ho, to ye text wahan dikhega. Accessibility aur SEO ke liye ye bohot zaroori hai.
Self-closing tag ka end. Kyunki img tag me koi text andar nahi likhte, isliye hum bas > se isse band kar dete hain.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Img tag ke liye konsa closing tag sahi hai?
Photo ka address batane wale attribute ka naam _______ hai.

practice_reps.instruction: Ek online image ka link laga kar photo dikhao.
Alt text ke saath ek aur image tag likho.

quiz_after_practice.question: Agar image load na ho, to user ko kya dikhega?

lessons.mini_task:
Ek 'My Gallery' page banao jisme h1 title ho, uske niche 3 alag-alag images add karo (internet se koi bhi URL le lo) aur har image ke niche ek

tag se photo ka description likho.
lessons.why_it_matters: Social media ho ya e-commerce, bina images ke web internet boring hai. Ye users ka dhyan khinchne ka sabse bada tool hai.
lessons.common_mistake: Beginners aksar tag likhne ki koshish karte hain jo galat hai. Bas likhna kaafi hai.

lessons.title: Lists (Ordered aur Unordered)
lessons.concept: Socho tum grocery list bana rahe ho. Agar order matter karta hai (jaise 1. Doodh, 2. Bread), to wo 'Ordered List' hai. Agar order matter nahi karta (jaise sirf bullet points), to wo 'Unordered List' hai. Web content ko bullet points me dikhane ke liye hum lists use karte hain.

code_breakdown.explain: 'Unordered List'. Ye bullet points wali list shuru karta hai.
'Ordered List'. Ye number wali (1, 2, 3) list shuru karta hai.
'List Item'. List ke andar jo har ek item hoga, use <li> tag ke andar likhna padega.
Har item ko khatam karne ke liye closing tag.
Puri list ko band karne ke liye closing tags.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Bullet points wali list ke liye kaunsa tag use hota hai?
Har list item ke liye hum ______ tag use karte hain.

practice_reps.instruction: Apne 2 favourite fruits ki ek bullet point list banao.
Apne 2 main goals ki ek numbered list banao.

quiz_after_practice.question: Kya ek list ke andar dusri list daal sakte hain?

lessons.mini_task: Ek page banao jisme 'Daily Routine' heading ho. Pehle ek Ordered List (ol) me apni morning tasks likho (1, 2, 3), fir ek Unordered List (ul) me apni pasand ki cheezein (bullet points) likho.
lessons.why_it_matters: Navigation menu, product features, aur instructions dene ke liye lists web development ka basic building block hain.
lessons.common_mistake: Log <li> tag ko <ul> ke bahar likh dete hain. <li> hamesha <ul> ya <ol> tag ke andar hi hona chahiye.

lessons.title: HTML Attributes (id aur class)
lessons.concept: Socho tumhari class mein bahut saare students hain. Sabka naam alag hai (id) aur kuch students ka group ek jaisa uniform pehenta hai (class). HTML elements ko identify karne aur design (CSS) ke liye hum 'id' aur 'class' ka use karte hain.
lessons.example_code:
Ye ek unique paragraph hai.

Ye style wala text hai.

code_breakdown.explain: Ye ek 'Unique Identifier' hai. Ek page par ek 'id' ka naam sirf ek hi baar use ho sakta hai. Ye element ki pehchan hoti hai.
'Class' ek group banata hai. Ek page par bahut saare elements mein same 'class' ka naam use kar sakte ho. Ye styling ke liye bohot kaam aata hai.
ID aur Class ke naam hamesha quotes ke andar likhte hain.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Kaunsa attribute ek page par sirf ek baar use hona chahiye?
Group styling ke liye hum ______ ka use karte hain.

practice_reps.instruction: Ek paragraph ko 'intro' id do.
Do paragraphs ko 'highlight' class do.

quiz_after_practice.question: Agar mujhe 10 items ko ek saath design karna hai, to main kya use karunga?

lessons.mini_task: Ek page banao jisme h1 ko 'main-title' id do, aur 3 paragraphs banao jinki class 'info-text' rakho. Ye future me CSS styling ke liye kaam aayega.
lessons.why_it_matters: Jab tum CSS (design) seekhoge, tab bina class aur id ke tum elements ko select nahi kar paoge.
lessons.common_mistake: Beginners id aur class ke beech confusion karte hain. Yaad rakho: ID ek ke liye, Class group ke liye.

lessons.title: Div (Division) - Layout ka Dabba
lessons.concept: Socho tum saman pack kar rahe ho. Tum chote saman ko ek bade cardboard box (div) mein daalte ho taki sab organized rahe. Web page par elements ko group karne aur unhe ek jagah rakhne ke liye <div> ka use hota hai.
lessons.example_code:
Mera Website

Main content yahan hai.

code_breakdown.explain: 'Division' tag. Ye ek container (dabba) jaisa hai. Iske andar tum images, links, ya headings daal sakte ho.
Division container ko band karne ke liye closing tag.
Div ka apna koi visual effect nahi hota, ye bas elements ko ek saath hold karta hai.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Div tag ka main kaam kya hai?
Div ko band karne ke liye ______ tag use hota hai.

practice_reps.instruction: Ek div banao jiske andar heading aur paragraph ho.
Div ko 'container' class do.

quiz_after_practice.question: Kya ek div ke andar dusra div aa sakta hai?

lessons.mini_task: Ek page banao jisme 'Header' naam ka div ho (usme h1 daalo) aur 'Main-Section' naam ka div ho (usme 2 paragraph daalo). Tumne abhi apni website ka structure banana seekh liya hai!
lessons.why_it_matters: Modern web design pura <div> aur layout par tikka hai. Bina boxes ke tum content ko sahi position par nahi la paoge.
lessons.common_mistake: Div ko hamesha open karke close karna bhool jana. Hamesha check karo ki tumne lagaya hai ya nahi.

lessons.title: HTML Boilerplate: Website ki Buniyad
lessons.concept: Socho tum ek letter likh rahe ho. Uska ek format hota hai—Date, Subject, Body. HTML file mein bhi browser ko batane ke liye ki 'ye ek HTML page hai', kuch zaroori code pehle likhna padta hai. Ise 'Boilerplate' kehte hain.

code_breakdown.explain: Ye browser ko batata hai ki hum HTML5 (latest version) use kar rahe hain. Ye tag close nahi hota.
Ye 'root' tag hai. Iske andar hi pura code likha jata hai.
Yahan website ki technical jankari hoti hai jo user ko screen par nahi dikhti (jaise tab ka title).
Ye browser ke upar jo tab (naam) dikhta hai, wo set karta hai.
Jo bhi tum screen par dikhana chahte ho (text, image, button), wo isi tag ke andar aayega.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Website ka dikhne wala content kahan likhte hain?
Tab ka title set karne ke liye ______ tag use hota hai.

practice_reps.instruction: Boilerplate complete karo.
Ek naya tag add karo jisse browser ko pata chale ye HTML5 hai.

quiz_after_practice.question: Kya <html> tag ke bina HTML page chalega?

lessons.mini_task: Ek proper boilerplate file banao jisme title 'My First Site' ho aur body mein tumhara naam ek h1 mein ho.
lessons.why_it_matters: Professional web development mein bina is structure ke kaam karna impossible hai, ye browser ki language hai.
lessons.common_mistake: Beginners <head> mein wo chizein daal dete hain jo <body> mein honi chahiye. Yaad rakho: Head = Information, Body = Content.

lessons.title: Attributes: Id aur Class ka Advance Use
lessons.concept: Ab tak tumne dekha ki elements kaise banate hain. Attributes (id, class, style) un elements ko 'extra superpowers' dete hain. Socho HTML ek insaan hai, to attributes uske kapde aur accessories hain jo use alag dikhate hain.
lessons.example_code:
Chaman Tech

Mobile coding is fun!

code_breakdown.explain: ID ek element ki unique pehchan hai. Kisi aur element ka ID 'main-header' nahi ho sakta.
Class ka use karke tum ek hi design (CSS) bahut saare elements par apply kar sakte ho.
Ek hi tag ke andar tum id, class, ya aur bhi attributes (jaise lang, title) ek saath laga sakte ho.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Kya ek element mein id aur class dono ho sakte hain?
Ek element ko unique identity dene ke liye ______ use hota hai.

practice_reps.instruction: Is paragraph ko id 'para1' aur class 'blue-text' do.
Do alag h1 tags ko same class 'heading' do.

quiz_after_practice.question: Agar mujhe 100 jagah design apply karna hai, toh best kya hai?

lessons.mini_task: Ek page banao jisme 3 paragraphs hon. Sabko 'my-text' class do, aur 2nd paragraph ko 'special' id do.
lessons.why_it_matters: Jab tum JS ya CSS seekhoge, tab tum yahi class aur id use karke elements ko control karoge.
lessons.common_mistake: ID ka naam space ke saath likhna (jaise id="main header"). Hamesha dash (-) ya underscore (_) ka use karo, space nahi.

lessons.title: Semantic Tags: Modern HTML ka Standard
lessons.concept: Pehle hum sab kuch <div> mein daalte the, par ab Google aur browsers ko batana padta hai ki ye 'header' hai, ye 'footer' hai. Semantic tags ka matlab hai aise tags jo apne naam se hi apna kaam batate hain. Ye SEO (Google ranking) ke liye bohot zaroori hain.

code_breakdown.explain: Website ka top part, jisme logo ya main menu hota hai.
Ye page ka main content hai. Ek page par ek hi main tag hona chahiye.
Page ke alag-alag bhaag, jaise 'About me' section ya 'Gallery' section.
Sabse niche wala part, jahan social links ya copyright info hoti hai.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Google SEO ke liye kaunse tags best hain?
Page ka main content ______ tag mein hona chahiye.

practice_reps.instruction: Header aur Footer tags ka structure banao.

quiz_after_practice.question: Kya <div> tag use karna galat hai?

lessons.mini_task: Ek proper structure banao: Header, Main, aur Footer. Main ke andar ek <section> daalo jisme tumhari skills ki list (ul/li) ho.
lessons.why_it_matters: Aajkal koi bhi <div>-soup (har jagah div) pasand nahi karta. Semantic tags se code clean aur readable rehta hai.
lessons.common_mistake: Sab kuch <section> mein daal dena. Har choti chiz section nahi hoti, sirf logical parts ko section mein rakho.

lessons.title: HTML Forms: Input lena seekho
lessons.concept: Agar tum chahte ho ki user tumhari website par apna naam, email, ya message likhe, to tumhe 'Form' chahiye. Form ke bina interactivity impossible hai. Ye trending projects (jaise Login/Sign-up) ka sabse important hissa hai.
lessons.example_code:
<form>
  <input type="text" placeholder="Naam likho">
  <input type="email" placeholder="Email">
  <button type="submit">Submit</button>
</form>

code_breakdown.explain: Ye ek container hai jo saare inputs ko ek saath band karta hai.
Normal text likhne ke liye.
Email validate karta hai (check karta hai ki @ hai ya nahi).
Input box ke andar jo light text dikhta hai jo user ko batata hai ki kya likhna hai.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Email ke liye best input type kya hai?
User ko hint dene ke liye ______ attribute use hota hai.

practice_reps.instruction: Ek login form ka structure banao.

quiz_after_practice.question: Kya form bina button ke kaam karega?

lessons.mini_task: Ek 'Contact Me' form banao jisme Name, Email, aur Message (input type='text') fields hon aur ek 'Send' button ho.
lessons.why_it_matters: Koi bhi professional app (Facebook, Instagram, Portfolio) bina forms ke adhura hai. Ye hi user ka data server tak le jata hai.
lessons.common_mistake: Placeholder ko value samajh lena. Placeholder bas dikhane ke liye hota hai, wo user ka input save nahi karta.

lessons.title: HTML Tables: Data ko Organize karna
lessons.concept: Socho tumhari school ki marksheet ya kisi cheez ka rate card. HTML tables ka use data ko rows aur columns mein dikhane ke liye hota hai. Professional dashboards aur reports mein ye aaj bhi trending hain.

code_breakdown.explain: Puri table ka main container.
'Table Row'. Ek horizontal line banane ke liye.
'Table Header'. Ye text ko bold aur center karta hai (headings ke liye).
'Table Data'. Ye normal cell hai jisme tum content dalte ho.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Table ki heading ke liye kaunsa tag best hai?
Table row banane ke liye ______ tag ka use karte hain.

practice_reps.instruction: Ek choti table banao jisme 'Name' aur 'Status' ho.

quiz_after_practice.question: Kya <td> tag <th> ke andar aa sakta hai?

lessons.mini_task: Ek 'Product Price List' banao jisme kam se kam 3 rows hon (Product Name, Material, Price).
lessons.why_it_matters: Admin panels, billing software, aur inventory apps banane ke liye tables basic requirement hain.
lessons.common_mistake: Tag ko band karna bhool jana. Har ke liye aur har ke liye zaroori hai.

lessons.title: Iframe: Doosri websites ko embed karna
lessons.concept: Socho apni website par tum kisi aur ki website ka chhota sa window dikha rahe ho (jaise Google Maps ya YouTube video). Iframe ek aisi window hai jo dusri website ko tumhare page ke andar load karti hai.

code_breakdown.explain: Inline frame. Iska use external content dikhane ke liye hota hai.
Yahan wo URL aata hai jise tum embed karna chahte ho.
Iframe ka size control karne ke liye attributes (jaise width='500' height='300').

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Dusri website embed karne ke liye kaunsa tag hai?
Iframe ka size set karne ke liye ______ aur height use karte hain.

practice_reps.instruction: Ek iframe banao jo ek website load kare.

quiz_after_practice.question: Kya har website iframe mein load ho sakti hai?
options: Nahi, kuch websites block karti hain
quiz_after_practice.answer: Nahi, kuch websites block karti hain

lessons.mini_task: Ek page banao jisme ek heading 'My Watchlist' ho aur uske niche ek YouTube video ka iframe lagao.
lessons.why_it_matters: Maps, videos, aur external tools embed karne ke liye professional sites iframe use karti hain.
lessons.common_mistake: Galat URL dalna. Youtube par 'Share' > 'Embed' ka option use karke jo link milta hai, wahi src mein dalna chahiye.

lessons.title: Meta Tags: SEO ka Secret
lessons.concept: Socho tumne ek kitab likhi, par uska cover page nahi hai. Google ko kaise pata chalega ki tumhari website kis baare mein hai? Meta tags website ki 'identity card' hote hain jo search engine ko batate hain ki site kis bare mein hai.
lessons.example_code:
<meta name="description" content="Chaman ka personal portfolio website">
<meta name="author" content="Chaman">

code_breakdown.explain: Metadata tag. Ye page ki information deta hai. Iska koi closing tag nahi hota.
Ye batata hai ki page ka short summary kya hai.
Jo info Google ko dikhani hai, wo yahan likhte hain.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Meta tags kahan likhe jate hain?
Meta tags ka closing tag ______ hai.

practice_reps.instruction: Ek description meta tag add karo.
practice_reps.starter_code: <meta name="description" ______="Best HTML Guide for Mobile Users">

quiz_after_practice.question: Kya meta tags user ko screen par dikhte hain?
options: Nahi, ye browser ke liye hote hain
quiz_after_practice.answer: Nahi, ye browser ke liye hote hain

lessons.mini_task: Apne boilerplate mein 2 meta tags add karo: ek description ke liye aur ek author (apna naam) ke liye.
lessons.why_it_matters: SEO (Search Engine Optimization) ke bina website Google par kabhi rank nahi karegi. Profesional developers ise hamesha use karte hain.
lessons.common_mistake: Meta tags ko <body> mein daalna. Meta tags hamesha <head> ke andar hone chahiye.

lessons.title: Form ke Advanced Input Types
lessons.concept: Sirf 'text' input kafi nahi hota. Agar user se password lena hai, date select karwani hai, ya range (slider) deni hai, to HTML ke paas special 'type' attributes hain. Ye user ka kaam aasaan karte hain aur data sahi format mein milta hai.
lessons.example_code:
<input type="password" placeholder="Password">
<input type="date">
<input type="range" min="1" max="100">

code_breakdown.explain: Ye input characters ko dots (●●●) mein convert kar deta hai taaki koi peeche se na dekh sake.
Ye mobile par ek calendar picker open karta hai, jisse date select karna super easy hota hai.
Ek slider banata hai. Iske sath min aur max attributes use hote hain range define karne ke liye.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Password hide karne ke liye kaunsa type best hai?
Slider banane ke liye ______ type use hota hai.

practice_reps.instruction: Ek password field banao.
Date select karne wala input banao.

quiz_after_practice.question: Kya type="date" mobile par calendar dikhata hai?

lessons.mini_task: Ek 'Profile Setup' form banao jisme Password, Date of Birth (type date), aur Rating (type range) ho.
lessons.why_it_matters: User experience (UX) ke liye sahi input type choose karna bahut zaroori hai. Galat type use karne se user frustrate ho jata hai.
lessons.common_mistake: Password field ke liye type="text" use karna. Hamesha security ke liye password type hi use karo.

lessons.title: Radio Buttons aur Checkboxes
lessons.concept: Jab user ko bahut saare options mein se choose karna ho, tab hum Radio aur Checkboxes use karte hain. Radio = Ek hi option chunna (jaise Gender), Checkbox = Ek se zyada chunna (jaise Hobbies).
lessons.example_code:
<input type="radio" name="gender"> Male
<input type="checkbox"> Music
<input type="checkbox"> Gaming

code_breakdown.explain: Sirf ek option select karne ke liye. 'name' attribute inka group banata hai.
Multiple options select karne ke liye (tick mark).
Radio buttons mein 'name' same rakhna zaruri hai, tabhi wo ek group bante hain.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Multiple options select karne ke liye kya use karein?
Ek group banane ke liye radio buttons mein ______ attribute same hona chahiye.

practice_reps.instruction: Do radio buttons (Male/Female) banao.
practice_reps.starter_code:
<input type="radio" name="gen"> Male
<input type="radio" name="gen"> Female

quiz_after_practice.question: Kya checkboxes mein 'name' same hona compulsory hai?

lessons.mini_task: Ek 'Survey' form banao jisme 'Gender' (Radio) aur 'Interests' (Checkbox - Coding, Design, Sports) ho.
lessons.why_it_matters: Form submission aur data collection ke liye ye basic tags hain. Bina inke tum user ki preferences nahi jaan paoge.
lessons.common_mistake: Radio buttons ko group na karna. Bina same 'name' attribute ke, user saare radio buttons select kar payega, jo galat hai.

lessons.title: Select Dropdown aur Textarea
lessons.concept: Jab options ki list badi ho (jaise City select karna), to 50 radio buttons dikhane ke bajaye 'Dropdown' list best hai. Aur agar lambi story ya feedback likhwana ho, to 'Textarea' use hota hai.

code_breakdown.explain: Dropdown menu ka start container.
Dropdown ke andar ka har ek item.
Multiline text box. Iska koi 'value' attribute nahi hota, text tags ke beech likhte hain.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Dropdown banane ke liye kaunsa tag hai?
Lambi text ke liye ______ tag best hai.

practice_reps.instruction: Ek city dropdown banao.

quiz_after_practice.question: Kya textarea ko close karna padta hai?

lessons.mini_task: Ek Feedback form banao: Name (input), City (Dropdown), aur Feedback (Textarea).
lessons.why_it_matters: Bade forms ko clean aur professional rakhne ke liye dropdowns aur textarea industry standard hain.
lessons.common_mistake: Textarea ke andar 'value' attribute dhundna. Textarea ka content uske opening aur closing tag ke beech likha jata hai.

lessons.title: Label tag: Form accessibility
lessons.concept: Socho ek input box hai par user ko pata hi nahi ki usme kya likhna hai. <label> tag input ke saath ek text jodta hai. Jab tum label par click karte ho, to input apne aap activate ho jata hai. Professional sites mein ise bina label ke form nahi banta.

code_breakdown.explain: Input ke liye descriptive text.
Ye attribute label ko input ki id se connect karta hai. dono ka name same hona chahiye.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Label ko input se link karne ke liye kya use hota hai?
Label ka 'for' aur input ki ______ same honi chahiye.

practice_reps.instruction: Email ke liye ek label banao.

quiz_after_practice.question: Label click karne se kya hota hai?

lessons.mini_task: Ek name aur password field banao, dono ke liye <label> use karo.
lessons.why_it_matters: Accessibility (A11y) ke liye ye mandatory hai. Screen readers blind users ko ye label padh kar sunate hain.
lessons.common_mistake: Label ke 'for' mein input ka 'name' dalna, jabki wahan input ki 'id' aani chahiye.

lessons.title: HTML Entities: Special Symbols
lessons.concept: HTML mein kuch symbols reserve hote hain jaise '<' ya '>'. Agar tumhe page par 'Copyright ©' ya 'less than <' print karna hai, to browser confuse ho sakta hai. Iske liye hum 'Entities' use karte hain.

code_breakdown.explain: © symbol ke liye.
'less than' (<) symbol ke liye.
'greater than' (>) symbol ke liye.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Copyright symbol ke liye kya use karein?
Less than symbol ke liye ______ use hota hai.

practice_reps.instruction: Ek line likho: 'Price > 100'

quiz_after_practice.question: Kya ye code browser me text ki tarah dikhega?

lessons.mini_task: Footer mein apna naam aur Copyright © 2026 likho.
lessons.why_it_matters: Professional web pages mein symbols ka use bahut hota hai. Ye code clean aur bug-free rakhta hai.
lessons.common_mistake: Entity ke baad semicolon (;) bhool jana. &copy likhne se kaam nahi chalega, © likhna padega.

lessons.title: Hidden Inputs: Data jo dikhta nahi
lessons.concept: Kabhi-kabhi tumhe form submit karte waqt aisi info bhejni hoti hai jo user ko nahi dikhani (jaise user_id ya token). Iske liye type="hidden" use karte hain. Ye security aur backend process mein bohot trending hai.

code_breakdown.explain: Ye browser mein render nahi hota (user ko nahi dikhega).
Jo data background mein server ko bhejna hai, wo yahan likhte hain.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Kya hidden input page par dikhta hai?
Hidden data store karne ke liye ______ attribute use hota hai.

practice_reps.instruction: Ek hidden input banao jiski value 'admin' ho.

quiz_after_practice.question: Hidden inputs kahan use hote hain?

lessons.mini_task: Ek login form banao jisme visible fields ho, aur ek hidden field jisme 'form_type' = 'login' bhejo.
lessons.why_it_matters: Login sessions aur tracking ke liye real-world apps mein hidden inputs ka bohot bada role hai.
lessons.common_mistake: Isme sensitive password store karna. Hidden field browser mein 'Inspect Element' karke dikh jati hai, isliye isme sirf non-sensitive data rakhte hain.

lessons.title: HTML5 Audio aur Video
lessons.concept: Pehle media chalane ke liye plugins chahiye hote the, par HTML5 mein ab ye built-in hai. Socho tumhari portfolio site par tumhara intro video ya koi audio track hai, ye tags use direct control dete hain.

code_breakdown.explain: Media file embed karne ke liye main tags.
Ye attribute play, pause, aur volume ke buttons browser ko dikhane ke liye bolta hai.
Media file ka path/link.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Play/Pause buttons dikhane ke liye kaunsa attribute zaroori hai?
Video file ke liye ______ tag ka use hota hai.

practice_reps.instruction: Ek video tag banao jisme controls ho.

quiz_after_practice.question: Kya bina controls attribute ke video chalegi?
options: Haan, par user control nahi kar payega
quiz_after_practice.answer: Haan, par user control nahi kar payega

lessons.mini_task: Ek page banao jisme ek video player ho aur uske niche ek audio player.
lessons.why_it_matters: Content websites, blogs, aur education platforms ke liye media embedding basic skill hai.
lessons.common_mistake: Controls attribute ko bhool jana, jisse user video ko play hi nahi kar pata.

lessons.title: Head tag ke andar SEO Tags
lessons.concept: Professional websites ke liye 'View Source' karne par bahut kuch dikhta hai. <head> section mein kuch aise tags hote hain jo Google ko batate hain ki page kaisa dikhna chahiye aur kaise rank karna chahiye. Ise 'Meta SEO' kehte hain.
lessons.example_code:
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<meta name="keywords" content="HTML, Coding, Chaman">
<link rel="icon" href="favicon.ico">

code_breakdown.explain: Mobile-friendly design ke liye sabse important tag. Iske bina site mobile par chhoti dikhegi.
Google ko batane ke liye ki tumhari site kin words par search honi chahiye.
Browser tab mein jo chhota sa icon dikhta hai, use set karta hai.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Mobile-friendly site ke liye kaunsa meta tag zaruri hai?
Tab ke icon ke liye ______ tag use hota hai.

practice_reps.instruction: Viewport meta tag complete karo.

quiz_after_practice.question: Keywords meta tag ka fayda kya hai?

lessons.mini_task: Ek proper boilerplate banao jisme viewport tag ho aur ek favicon (icon) link ho.
lessons.why_it_matters: Google search mein rank karne ke लिए viewport aur keywords tag hi foundation hote hain.
lessons.common_mistake: Viewport tag ko ignore karna, jisse website desktop jaisi mobile par chhoti-chhoti dikhti hai.

lessons.title: Canvas: HTML par Drawing
lessons.concept: Socho tum HTML ko ek drawing sheet ki tarah use kar rahe ho. <canvas> ek area hota hai jahan tum JavaScript ki madad se graphics, charts, ya games draw kar sakte ho. Aajkal ke browser-based games isi par chalte hain.

code_breakdown.explain: Drawing ka khali container. Iske andar hum JS se shape ya image draw karte hain.
Canvas ki dimension set karna zaroori hai, warna wo default size lega.
Canvas invisible hota hai, isliye border dena zaroori hai takki tumhe pata chale wo kahan hai.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Canvas par drawing karne ke liye kya zaroori hai?
Canvas ka container tag ______ hai.

practice_reps.instruction: Ek 300x300 ka canvas banao.

quiz_after_practice.question: Kya bina JavaScript ke canvas mein kuch dikhega?

lessons.mini_task: Ek page banao jisme canvas tag ho jiska size 500x500 ho aur border blue rang ka ho.
lessons.why_it_matters: Data visualization (Charts) aur browser games ke liye canvas aajkal industry ka king hai.
lessons.common_mistake: Canvas ko <div> ki tarah samajhna. Canvas ke andar koi text ya image bina JS ke nahi daal sakte.

lessons.title: Data Attributes (data-*): Custom Info
lessons.concept: Kabhi tumhe HTML element mein extra info chupani hoti hai jo normal user ko na dikhe par JavaScript ko chahiye ho? Tab hum 'data-' attribute use karte hain. Ye custom superpowers dene jaisa hai.

code_breakdown.explain: Koi bhi attribute jo 'data-' se start ho, use custom attribute maana jata hai.
Custom variable jo JS mein access kiya ja sakta hai.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Custom data store karne ke liye kya prefix use hota hai?
Data attributes ka main maqsad ______ ke liye data rakhna hai.

practice_reps.instruction: Ek button banao jisme 'id' 101 ho.

quiz_after_practice.question: Kya ye data page par display hota hai?

lessons.mini_task: 3 product elements banao, har ek mein 'data-price' attribute set karo.
lessons.why_it_matters: Frontend frameworks (React/Vue) mein backend se data link karne ke liye ye best practice hai.
lessons.common_mistake: data- ke baad space dena. Ye hamesha chipka ke likhna chahiye (e.g., data-price).

lessons.title: HTML Cleanup aur Best Practices
lessons.concept: Code likhna aasan hai, par 'saaf' code likhna mushkil. HTML cleanup ka matlab hai proper indentation, comments ka use, aur redundant tags ko hatana. Professional developer wahi hai jiska code dusra insaan aasani se samajh sake.

code_breakdown.explain: HTML comments. Ye code mein notes likhne ke liye hote hain, browser ise ignore kar deta hai.
Code ko hierarchy ke hisab se aage-peeche (tab) likhna, jisse structure samajh aaye.

quiz_after_breakdown.question: Browser comments ko kya karta hai?
HTML mein comment ki shuruaat ______ se hoti hai.

practice_reps.instruction: Ek comment likho 'This is my content'.

quiz_after_practice.question: Clean code ka sabse bada fayda kya hai?

lessons.mini_task: Apne pichle kisi bhi project ko uthao, usmein har section ke upar comment daalo aur code ko perfectly align karo.
lessons.why_it_matters: Real-world projects hazaro lines ke hote hain. Bina comments aur alignment ke tum khud ka code 1 mahine baad nahi samajh paoge.
lessons.common_mistake: Comments mein sensitive info (password/keys) likhna. Comments code mein public hote hain!
